CustomField.description: Calculated end date of the renewal period from order end date and renewal period months.
CustomField.formula: DATE( YEAR(EndDate) + FLOOR((MONTH(EndDate) + Renewal_Period_Months__c - 1) / 12), MOD(MONTH(EndDate) + Renewal_Period_Months__c - 1, 12) + 1, DAY(EndDate) )
CustomField.label: Renewal end date
